description: Security profile for an OT device: its NVD CVEs (newest first), its CISA ICS advisories (full CSAF history), and a model-written hardening profile (default-credential risk, OT protocols at risk, hardening steps; labelled by profile_provenance). Not an internet exposure scan. Price: $0.05 USDC per call via x402 on Base mainnet. An unpaid call returns an x402 PaymentRequired challenge; retry the identical call with the signed payload in _meta["x402/payment"].

model.description: Device model e.g. s7-1200, modicon-m340, controllogix, vision. With a model, NVD is searched for the model name

vendor.description: Vendor e.g. siemens, schneider, rockwell, honeywell, unitronics, ge, beckhoff

name: getDeviceExposure
title: OT Device Security Profile
